successCriteria.description: The test file web/src/modules/approvals/approvals.service.test.ts exists beside its subject and instantiates ApprovalsService directly with in-memory fakes for ILeaveService and IEmployeeService (cast to the interface types imported from web/src/modules/leave/index.ts and web/src/modules/employee/index.ts).

getQueue() happy path: given a MANAGER/ADMIN profile and a list containing SUBMITTED rows (including one owned by the viewer) plus DRAFT/APPROVED/REJECTED/CANCELLED rows, the result contains only SUBMITTED rows whose employeeId !== profile.id, and each returned item has employeeName === null and status === LeaveStatus.SUBMITTED.
getQueue() empty state: when no SUBMITTED non-own rows exist, getQueue() resolves to [] (empty result is a normal condition, not an error).
getQueue() failure path: when getMe() or list() rejects, the rejection propagates unchanged (asserted via await expect(promise).rejects.toBe(error)).

decide(requestId, 'approve') delegates to leaveService.approve(requestId) and returns the resulting LeaveRequestView unchanged; decide(requestId, 'reject') delegates to leaveService.reject(requestId) and returns the resulting LeaveRequestView unchanged.
decide() failure path: when the underlying approve/reject rejects, the rejection propagates unchanged.

constraints: Use Vitest (describe/expect/it/vi) with vi.fn() fakes; assert calls with toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1), toHaveBeenCalledWith(...), not.toHaveBeenCalled(); use toBe for identity and toEqual for value equality; assert rejections with await expect(promise).rejects.toBe(error).

Provide helper factories (e.g. makeLeaveService(overrides) and makeEmployeeService(overrides)) returning the full ILeaveService/IEmployeeService interfaces, with unused methods rejecting via Promise.reject(new ApiError('unused', 0)); import ApiError from ../../infrastructure/api/index.
Tests must not import a pool, API client, or module-level db helper; the subject under test is the pure orchestration ApprovalsService, so fakes are in-memory and no network/HTTP is exercised.

The test file must not prescribe or assert implementation shape (no HTTP methods/paths, no component names beyond the existing ApprovalsService/IApprovalsService/ApprovalsQueueItem exports, no field lists beyond the documented ApprovalsQueueItem mapping).
outOfScope: No integration/e2e tests, no real API client, no HTTP layer, no persistence — this phase is unit tests only, using in-memory fakes.
No role-based authorization assertions in getQueue() (the viewer's role has no effect on filtering); no testing of ILeaveService/IEmployeeService internals.

entityInvariants.invariant: ApprovalsQueueItem is a derived read-model projection, never persisted; every item in a getQueue() result has status === LeaveStatus.SUBMITTED and employeeName === null, and its employeeId is never the signed-in viewer's id.

ApprovalsService is stateless; getQueue() derives membership from LeaveRequestView rows (status === SUBMITTED and employeeId !== profile.id) and decide() delegates verbatim to ILeaveService.approve/reject, returning the LeaveRequestView unchanged.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Identity comes from employeeService.getMe(); the viewer's role is not consulted by the filtering logic.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Errors from getMe() or list() propagate unchanged; an empty result is a normal [] return, not an error.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth logic in the service; it delegates to ILeaveService which owns the bearer-token/authorization handling.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Errors from approve/reject propagate unchanged; the returned LeaveRequestView is passed through verbatim.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: Fake ILeaveService must satisfy the ILeaveService interface (list/getById/create/submit/approve/reject/cancel) as declared in web/src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts.
Fake IEmployeeService must satisfy the IEmployeeService interface (getMe) as declared in web/src/modules/employee/employee.service.ts.
ApprovalsQueueItem mapping must match the fields declared in web/src/modules/approvals/approvals.service.ts (requestId, employeeId, employeeName, leaveTypeCode, startDate, endDate, status).
Shared enums/types (LeaveStatus, LeaveTypeCode, LeaveRequestView, EmployeeProfile, EmployeeRole) must be imported from web/src/shared/types/index.ts and match its definitions.
Test conventions (fake factories, vi.fn typing, assertion style, ApiError import) must match web/src/modules/leave/leave.service.test.ts and web/src/modules/employee/employee.service.test.ts.

integrationPoints.why: Subject under test; ApprovalsService, IApprovalsService, ApprovalsQueueItem, ApprovalDecision are imported from here.
ILeaveService interface type imported for the fake leave service.
IEmployeeService interface type imported for the fake employee service.
Shared enums and view/profile types used to build fixtures and assert results.
